items.title: SLA negotiations & RFPs

details.heading: What we need to start your calculations
details.lead: To build your precise operational model, our team just needs three primary data sets. To make the process as seamless as possible, we provide ready-to-use templates you can easily fill out.

rows.title: Flight Schedule
paragraphs: A complete list of all arrivals and departures. We accept any standard daily or seasonal formats (such as Excel, CSV, or IATA SSIM codes).

image.alt: Imported flight schedule overview: flights, movements, passengers and peak hour, with flights per airline over time and the schedule list

rows.title: Planning Rules & Labor Parameters
paragraphs: Your specific ground handling constraints, including shift types, working hours, rest time rules, and mandatory break times.

image.alt: Planning rules by airline with task start and end times, staff quantity, colours and qualifications

rows.title: Employee Information
paragraphs: Current station roles, positions, qualifications, and employment types so the engine factors in actual operational compliance.

image.alt: Employee information: staff list with hire dates, job titles and qualifications, and the edit staff form
